_about: The one place that names where rule networks live. build.mjs reads it to write the HOCON tools, link_labels, allowed_peers, both links.json files and the deploy-root/ folder. The deployed set uses jsDelivr with a release tag: replace @TAG in every URL with the real tag before building (build.mjs refuses to build the deployed set while @TAG is left). The rule networks sit in a short folder ad/ at the repository root so the runtime's 60-character tool names stay distinct. See README-deploy.md.

labels.aca_appeal_rules: ACA appeal rules, published by Appeal Desk
labels.erisa_claims_rules: ERISA claims rules, published by Appeal Desk
labels.medicare_advantage_rules: Medicare Advantage rules, published by Appeal Desk
